worldcombat.skill.clamp.summary: Closes its thick shell around an adjacent foe and pins it in place: the target cannot move, and the caster cannot move or start new moves either, while the shell grinds again and again until the full duration or until they are torn apart. Grind adds more, longer-held crunches; Quick releases sooner with heavier crunches.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.use.0: Pin a hard target that charged in until allies finish it
worldcombat.skill.clamp.use.1: Wear down a large foe that closed to melee with shell thickness
worldcombat.skill.clamp.use.2: Lock down one key target in a narrow spot
worldcombat.skill.clamp.use.3: Trade your own stillness for the foe's
worldcombat.skill.clamp.description.0: Each grind deals about %1$s damage to the held target; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.description.1: The shell stays closed for %1$s, grinding every %2$s; the target is pinned and cannot move, and the caster cannot move or start new moves either.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.description.2: It holds at up to %1$s blocks apart and steps in up to %2$s blocks on cast; being torn apart or either side falling releases it.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.option.on: Grind on: each crunch about x0.62 and the interval about x0.72, but the hold about x1.25 with more crunches and both of you pinned longer, cooldown +10 ticks, for holding a target for your team.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.option.off: Grind off (Quick): each crunch at full power, a longer interval and a shorter hold so you both break away sooner, for strike-and-leave.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.timing: Cast on a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.growth.0: At level %1$s the crush rises to %2$s power and the hold to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.preference.grind: On: lighter crunches but more of them, a shorter interval and a longer hold, with both pinned longer, cooldown +10 ticks, for holding a hard target for your team. Off: full-power crunches, a longer interval and a shorter hold so both break away sooner.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.preference.ai.ma: The companion only clamps a threat within this distance; lower keeps it to melee, higher lets it circle in before closing.
worldcombat.skill.clamp.preference.ai.mi: Below this health ratio the companion will not start a clamp (pinning itself under fire is a bad trade); 0 clamps even when nearly down.
